name: Health Potion
lore: Brewed from shardroot and wishwater. Tastes faintly of copper.

name: Second Wind
lore: The Dominion believes in second chances. Third chances cost extra.

name: Memory Charm
desc: Keeps a missing memory fragment reachable on the map this run. Not consumed unless you actually collect one.
lore: A sliver of the Dominion's own recall, bound in glass. It hums toward what you've forgotten.

name: Ward Talisman
desc: Held passively. The next time you would lose a battle, this absorbs the loss — no life spent.
lore: Carved from a shard that refused to break twice. It only ever gets one more use in it.

name: Vigor Draught
desc: Permanently raise your base's max HP by 10 for the rest of this run.
lore: Doesn't heal so much as convince the wound it was never that deep to begin with.
